candidate_stages_untouched: trackb_production_run.py frozen and unchanged; same code path as the batch7 production run (candidate -> worthiness/link -> validator -> final record)
derived_from: docs/batch7_consolidation_v2.md open lead question (end-to-end reliability incl. silence); operationalizes it without adding hypotheses
diagnostic_status: DESIGN ONLY - not executed, no sentences built, no pipeline run
end_to_end_concept: system ASSERTS a triple for a sentence iff >=1 ACCEPT record exists for it; any other outcome (REJECT only, ABSTAIN only, no_candidate) counts as system SILENT for that sentence
evaluation_units: sentence level primary (the 2x2 above); pair correctness (accepted pair == gold pair?) as secondary line; ABSTAIN-only sentences count as silent with a separate marker, never as asserts
exclusion_leakage: fresh sentences only (no production corpora, no T1/T2/T2b/V-probe reuse; exact-text-match audit at build); entities fresh per item; no frozen changes; run via frozen script on a small probe-corpus file (new file at build time); router log window persisted to a probe log file (B7 lesson: no volatile-terminal-only provenance)
gold_rules: frozen operational definition reused unchanged; text-only blind annotation BEFORE the pipeline run; YES with provider/recipient spans, NO with null spans, UNCLEAR allowed and excluded from binary denominators (reported separately)
measurement_question: does the full system assert a triple exactly when it may (gold YES) and stay silent otherwise (gold NO)?
not_testing: any pipeline modification or threshold tuning
hit-rate chasing: the four error classes matter, not a single score
objective: measure end-to-end behavior (assert vs silence against gold) of the unchanged production pipeline on a small stratified probe
size: 32 sentences: 4 strata x 8 (TRUE-easy / TRUE-hard / FALSE candidate-prone / FALSE no-relation-silence)

strata.FALSE_candidate_prone: gold NO sentences in T2/T2b-style transfer-like or general-form frames; expectation: system silent (pairs may be produced, verdicts must reject)
strata.FALSE_no_relation_silence: gold NO sentences with no relational content at all; expectation: system silent (ideally no pairs)
strata.TRUE_easy: gold YES with canonical explicit SVO transfer frames; expectation: ACCEPT (validity stratum)
strata.TRUE_hard: gold YES in B6-observed difficult forms (passive-oblique, phrasal/idiom predicate, intransitive+PP); expectation open (this is the measurement); interpretation: primarily a candidate-generation recall stress test on known-hard forms; FALSE SILENCEs here license recall conclusions only, no general end-to-end weakness claims

technical_failures: frozen script behavior applies (abort on repeated validator failure); an aborted run is a technical failure: report and stop, no invented resume, no partial-run statistics

validity_and_reporting.descriptive_cells: TRUE-hard, FALSE-prone, FALSE-silence cells reported as raw 2x2 counts with denominators; no pass/fail threshold beyond validity
validity_and_reporting.validity_gate: TRUE-easy ACCEPT >=6/8, else the probe run is invalid (setup problem) and no end-to-end claim is made

status: DESIGN FROZEN FOR REVIEW - execution requires separate approval
unit_under_test: the complete frozen production pipeline end to end (not a single stage)
validator_provenance: local router (mode recorded at run time); per-request provider captured as in the V-probe run
